description: Elasticsearch is a distributed, RESTful search and analytics engine capable of addressing a growing number of use cases.
real_world_incidents: Massive data leaks involving PII exposed via unsecured Elasticsearch clusters.
recommended_actions: Require authentication for all REST endpoints.

audience_guidance.student: Elasticsearch stores massive amounts of logs and data. Like MongoDB, if exposed without auth, it's a goldmine for attackers.
audience_guidance.developer: Enable X-Pack security in elasticsearch.yml. Setup RBAC and require passwords for the elastic user.
audience_guidance.bug_bounty_hunter: Access /_cat/indices to see all data. Access /_search to dump contents.
audience_guidance.pentester: Check for unauthenticated access. On older versions (<1.2), check for RCE via dynamic scripting features.
audience_guidance.security_team: Ensure clusters are not internet-facing. Audit for X-Pack enablement. Alert on large data extraction queries.
